item.description:
Checks focus on what you are reading

  • Prioritizes the open email or main browser content, keeping sender details, message context and exposed link destinations together.
  • Adds conversation selection for Messages, WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal and Slack, where the app exposes a readable transcript.
  • Gives recent visible messages priority over chat lists and older history, with clear notes when content is omitted from an online check.
  • Reduces repeat chat uploads caused by sidebar changes, typing indicators and read receipts.
  • Reads exposed descriptions from native list rows when those rows provide no ordinary readable text.
  • Keeps reviewed text consistent with what is sent, including custom text filters and long conversations.

Local checks still inspect the wider readable capture. Saved monitoring, cloud, privacy and update preferences remain in place. App Accessibility support varies; hidden link destinations are available only when the app exposes them. Browser reading uses Accessibility and does not require a new extension. Coverage in individual clients is still being validated.
